contract.goal: The code the request names is restructured toward its target, such as duplicated logic moved to one place, without changing behavior or the public API, and the whole test suite passes.

deliverables.description: The restructured source at its real sites, plus any characterization tests added to pin current behavior

criteria.text: The whole test suite passes on the restructured code, shown by a real `npm run test` run

checks.label: green after the restructure (verified run receipt)

criteria.text: The structural problem the request names is measurably smaller in the real files, such as a duplicated block now living in one place

judge.rubric: Is the duplication, length or tangle the request names measurably reduced in the actual source files, not just claimed?

criteria.text: Observable behavior and the public API are unchanged unless the request asked for a break; no fix or feature slipped in, and no test was weakened or deleted

judge.rubric: Do exports, signatures and outputs behave exactly as before, with no smuggled fixes or features and every pre-existing test intact?

criteria.text: The reshaped code is covered by tests of its current behavior; characterization tests added where coverage was thin stay in the project's test layout

judge.rubric: Is every piece of code the refactor reshaped exercised by a test that pins its current behavior?
